notes: Central University of Vienna doctoral recruitment call (SSH Call 2026) for at least 40 salaried 4-year predoc positions across nine SSH doctoral schools. The official call site publishes a Supervisor Overview and per-school supervisor lists with research areas, institutional weblinks and univie.ac.at emails. Supervisors above are verified from the CoBeNe doctoral school page (explicitly named in the scholarship description); hundreds of further eligible supervisors exist at careers.univie.ac.at/en/praedoc/praedoc-ssh/liste-supervisor. Emails are published on official univie.ac.at pages.

DAAD Research Grants are a national German government scholarship scheme with no attached host institution. Applicants identify their own German host professor themselves - per the official DAAD page: 'you need to identify a professor at the German university who is willing to host you in her/his department'. No named supervising professor can be verified for this scheme; the supervisor varies per applicant.

DAAD University Summer Courses (HSK) is a national short-term language/cultural course grant at course providers chosen by the applicant; no degree supervision is involved. Not applicable for supervisor identification.

DAAD Helmut-Schmidt-Programme (PPGG) is funded by the German Federal Foreign Office and advertised in the central DAAD scholarship database; applications go directly to DAAD and successful applicants are allocated places on selected master's courses at seven German universities. No single institution or named professor is attached to the scholarship itself - not applicable for supervisor identification.

DAAD Study Scholarships in Architecture is a central DAAD database scheme at 'a state or state-recognised German university of your choice'; selection is by an anonymous DAAD committee of professors. No attached institution or named professor - not applicable for supervisor identification.

DAAD Study Scholarships in Fine Art, Design, Visual Communication and Film is a central DAAD database scheme at a university of the applicant's choice; selection is by a DAAD specialist committee. No attached institution or named professor - not applicable for supervisor identification.

DAAD Study Scholarships in the Performing Arts is a central DAAD database scheme at a university of the applicant's choice; for complementary studies a German university teacher's confirmation of supervision is arranged by the applicant. No named professor attached to the scheme itself - not applicable for supervisor identification.
